pages.title: Xytrian Runner
pages.description:
Navigate fast-paced obstacle courses using reflex-based dodge and jump mechanics in a neon-lit sci-fi world. Players must time their movements precisely to avoid hazards and maintain momentum through progressively complex levels filled with dynamic platforms. Collecting energy orbs boosts speed, challenging players to continuously improve their route and reaction time.

Key Features

• Reflex timing dodge mechanics  
• Momentum-based movement system  
• Progressive level complexity  
• Energy orb speed boosts  
• Neon sci-fi visual setting

pages.title: Funny Walk Fail Run
pages.description:
Navigate comically awkward movement sequences by controlling a character’s unsteady walk and unpredictable runs while overcoming various obstacles. The core mechanic revolves around timing and balancing erratic leg motions to avoid falls and progress through quirky levels that test reflexes. Survive challenging terrain to reach checkpoints and unlock new movement styles.

Key Features

• Leg coordination balancing mechanic  
• Unpredictable character locomotion  
• Obstacle navigation challenges  
• Progressive difficulty stages  
• Casual arcade visual style
